endorsements.quote: Caregivers should provide informed consent for the use of AI‐generated educational materials, and children should receive age‐appropriate explanations.

When AI‐generated videos are used for education or preparation, clinicians should disclose that the content is AI‐generated, explain its limitations, and ensure that information aligns with current clinical standards.

unlisted_practices: Prohibit sharing identifiable pediatric data in prompts to generative AI tools.
Evaluate vendor terms, data retention, and security controls before deploying AI tools.
Avoid fear-inducing or emotionally manipulative imagery and respect developmental stage and cultural context in AI-generated pediatric content.
Include low-tech alternatives, accessibility features, and multilingual options in AI implementation plans to address digital access disparities.
Subject educational use of unvalidated text-to-video AI content to expert review and treat it as exploratory.
Foster interdisciplinary collaboration among stakeholders, healthcare professionals, and technology developers in implementing generative AI.
